name: net_route_d15_2p
description: VUH-2344 one-PC stand-in for the D15 two-PC route. Host and friend both load FM-02 (Roxas, Day 6) with the player package's shipped defaults on an ENet loopback relay. The route pilot (VUH-2340) plays the host with real keyboard input, one route file per checkpoint; the friend gets no input, only follows, and is protected (team 0) because nobody plays it. After each segment, coop_verdict checks that every host room was followed to the same location and every progress version applied with the same hash, then a short friend clip is taken. Planned segments, added once their route files exist: tt1_solo (Roxas Day 6 -> Sora -> Yen Sid), hb1, worldmap_lod1 (World Map -> Asteroid Sweep -> LoD, tools/rig/route_pilot/routes/worldmap_lod1.json). Hang checks are off: a held friend's paused menu and the World Map stop field frames, and the pilot's stuck detector covers soft locks. Needs the pilot step and pilot.py from VUH-2340.

steps.message: FM-02 did not load in Twilight Town on both instances

steps.note: Roxas's prologue has no party, so transition_check's puppet test can't apply here
the first key-down after a focus switch is lost (VUH-2340): focus the host first
